Learning that the servants had been slain, their (i.e. the mothers of the sons of the councillors) mothers, along with their friends and kindred, were overpowered with grief.

sa: तं बलौघमपर्यन्तं देवैरपि सुदुःसहम्। आपतन्तं सुदुष्पारं समुद्रमिव पर्वणि॥ रथनागाश्वकलिलं शङ्खदुन्दुभिनादितम्। अनन्तरथपादातं रजसा सर्वतो वृतम्॥ तं भीमसेनः समरे महोदधिमिवापरम्। सेनासागरमक्षोभ्यं वेलेव समवारयत्॥
en: That infinite army, whose impetus it would have been impossible even for the gods to bear, that army which was incapable of being crossed like the sea on a Parva day, that army that swarmed with car-warriors, steeds and elephants and that resounded with the blare of conchs, the rattle of chariots, and the sound drums, that numbered numbered innumerable foot soldiers and car-warriors, that was shrouded in a cloud of dust-that veritable ocean of advancing hostile force that was incapable of being agitated, Bhimasena withstood in battle, like the banks resisting the surging sea.

sa: व्यवसायात्मिका बुद्धिरेकेह कुरुनन्दन। बहुशाखा हनन्ताश्च बुद्धयोऽव्यवसायिनाम्॥
en: In this, O son of Kuru, there is mind's but one state, consisting of firm devotion; whereas undevotional men's minds are many-branched and attached to endless pursuits.

sa: निहतैः क्षत्रियैः शूरैर्नानाजनपदेश्वरैः। जयगृद्धैर्वृता भूमिर्दारुणा समपद्यत॥
en: Then the field of battle assumed a dreadful aspect being strewn over with many slain heroic Kshatriya rulers of many countries, who had fought for securing victory.

sa: अथाप्लुत्य पदान्यष्टौ संनिपत्य गजाविव। सहसा लोहदण्डाभ्यामन्योन्यमभिजघ्नतुः॥
en: Leaping over space measuring eight steps and falling upon one another like two rival elephants, they began to strike with vehemence, one another, with their iron bludgeons.

sa: एवमुक्तास्तु ते राज्ञा सात्वतीपुत्रमभ्ययुः। संरब्धास्ते जिघांसन्तो भारद्वाजस्य पश्यतः॥
en: Thus spoken to, O king, they rushed against the son of Subhadra the daughter of the Satvata race, all inspired with wrath and a desire to slay the latter, before the very eyes of Bharadvaja's son.

sa: कर्णिकारमयीं मालां बिभ्रत्पादावलम्बिनीम्। त्रिभित्रैः कृतोद्योतस्त्रिभिः सूर्यैरिवोदितैः॥
en: He wears a garland of Karnikars flowers round his neck which reaches down his feet and which blazes with radiance with his three eyes resembling three suns.

sa: उद्धरेदात्मनाऽऽत्मानं नात्मानमवसादयेत्। आत्मैव ह्यात्मनो बन्धुरात्मैव रिपुरात्मनः॥
en: One should elevate his self by self one should not degrade his self a man's self is his friend and his own self is also his enemy.

sa: वासुदेवसहायाश्च महेन्द्रसमविक्रमाः। सर्वथाऽहं तु राजेन्द्र करिष्ये वचनं तव॥
en: They are supported by the son of Vasudeva himself in battle, and are endued with prowess equal to that of the great Indra himself. But, O foremost of kings, I will ever carry out your commands.

sa: युध्यमानस्य संयुगे। केच तस्मिंस्तनूंस्त्यक्त्वा प्रतीपं मृत्युमाव्रजन्॥
en: Who went before him when that hero fought in the battle? Who were they that courted death stood face to face to them regardless of their body?

sa: ततस्तव सुतो राजंश्चिन्तयाऽभिपरिप्लुतः। विस्रवच्छोणिताक्ताङ्गः पप्रच्छेदं पितामहम्॥
en: Then, O monarch, your son Duryodhana, covered with stains of blood all over the body, and overwhelmed with anxious thought, from confidence, asked the grandsire Bhishma saying;

sa: वीर्यवद्भिस्ततस्तैस्तु पीडितो राक्षसोत्तमः। यथा युगक्षये घोरे चन्द्रमाः पञ्चभिर्ग्रहै:॥
en: Then that foremost of the Rakshasas sorely affected by those warriors endued with prowess, appeared like the moon affected by the five planets at the time of the dreadful dissolution at the end of a Yuga.

sa: स हताश्वादवप्लुत्य च्छिन्नधन्वा रथोत्तमात्। सात्यकेराप्लुतो यानं गिर्यग्रमिव केसरी॥
en: Thereupon Bhima with his bow burst open, jumped down from his excellent chariot of which the steeds were slain and leapt upor the car of Satyaki like a lion leaping upon the top of a hill.

sa: चाभरव्यजनाक्षेपैरुदयन्निव भास्करः। प्रमुखे तस्य सैन्यस्य द्रोणोऽवस्थितनायकः॥
en: Fanned by the moving yak-tails, he appeared like the sun himself. In the very van of those troops was stationed Drona the generalissimo of the Kuru hosts.

sa: सर्वकालिङ्गसैन्यानां मनांसि समकम्पयत्। मोहश्चापि कलिङ्गानामाविवेश परंतप॥
en: With that tremendous sound the hearts of the Kalinga troops began to tremble in fear. O chastiser of foes, the Kalingas appeared to have lost all consciousness.

sa: स हताश्वादवप्लुत्य च्छिन्नधन्वा रथोत्तमात्। सात्यकेराप्लुतो यानं गिर्यग्रमिव केसरी॥
en: Thereupon Bhima with his bow burst open, jumped down from his excellent chariot of which the steeds were slain and leapt upor the car of Satyaki like a lion leaping upon the top of a hill.

sa: कौरवानभ्ययुस्तूर्ण हस्त्यश्वरथपत्तिभिः। समुच्छ्रितैर्ध्वजैश्छत्रैः शस्त्रैश्च विमलैः शितैः॥
en: Rushed against the Kauravas with impetuosity, supported by their elephantswarriors, car-warrior, cavalry and infantry as also with their standard, and umbrellas, and effulgent and shinning weapons upraised.

sa: शरौर्घविमलैस्तीक्ष्णैर्माद्रीपुत्राववारयन्। भीष्मस्तु संहतः संख्ये धातराष्ट्रैः ससैनिकैः॥
en: With a shower of resplendent shafts of exceeding sharpness, resisted the two sons of Pandu. In that battle Bhishma, supported by Dhritarashtra's sons along with their divisions,

sa: अपेतविध्वस्तमहार्हभूषणं निपातितं शक्रसमं महाबलम्। रणेऽभिमन्युं ददृशुस्तदा जना व्यपोढहव्यं सदसीव पावकम्॥
en: Then as they left if, they saw the mighty car-warrior Abhimanyu, who resembled Indra himself, lying on the field of battle, with precious ornaments displaced and falling off and appearing like a sacrificial fire on the alter no longer fed by oblations of clarified butter.

sa: तदभूद् ध्वजसम्बाधमकापुरुषसेवितम्। द्रोणानीकं महाराज पटे चित्रमिवार्पितम्॥
en: Then, O monarch, the host led by Drona, which abounded in myriad's of standards and which numbered not a single coward, looked like images painted on canvas.

sa: हन्यादेकरथेनैव देवगन्धर्वमानुषान्। एकीभूतानपि रणे दिव्यैरस्त्रैः प्रजापवान्॥
en: With the assistance of a single car he can slay the gods, the Gandharvas and the human beings united together, with the aid of his heavenly weapons.

sa: पौरवो राजशार्दूलस्तव राजन् महारथः। मतो मम रथोदारः परवीररथारुजः॥
en: That foremost of king, Pauravas, on your side, is a Maharatha, o king; such is my opinion; he is one of the foremost among carwarriors and will work havoc among the heroes on the enemies' side.

sa: ततस्तत् कुञ्जरानीकं व्यधमद् धृष्टमार्जुनिः। यथा वायुर्नित्यगतिर्जलदाशतशोऽम्बरे॥
en: Then the son of Arjuna began to crush that division of elephants, like the wind that blows in all directions destroying masses of clouds in the heaven.

sa: भारतामृतसर्वस्वगीताया मथितस्य च। सारमुद्धृत्य कृष्णेन अर्जुनस्य मुखे हुतम्॥
en: God Krishna churned Gita, the sole essence of the nectar in form of Bharata and the vital essence so extracted has been inserted in the mouth (in mind and savvy through ears) of Arjuna by him.

sa: न्यहनत् तावकांश्चापि सात्यकिः सत्यविक्रमः। निशितैर्बहुभिर्बाणैस्तेऽद्रवन्त भयार्दिताः॥
en: Then Satyaki of prowess incapable of being baffled, began to slaughter your warriors with many well-sharpened shafts; and afflicted with fear these latter began to break away.

sa: लोहिताक्षं महाबाहुं जातं सिंहमिवाद्रिषु। उपेन्द्रसदृशं ब्रत कथमायोधने हतः॥
en: Tell me, Oh, how that hero possessed of mighty arms and red eyes, who was born in our race, like a lion on the mountain breast and who resembled Upendra himself, has been slain in battle?

sa: विह्वलन्तो गता भूमि शैला इव धरातले॥ मेदोरुधिरदिग्धाङ्गो वसामज्जासमुक्षितः।
en: Some fell down on the grounds overwhelmed with terror, and they resembled huge hills and were soiled in every pare of their body with fat and blood, and were almost bathed in marrow and brain matter.

sa: वध्यतां राजपुत्राणां क्रन्दतामितरेतरम्। प्रादुरासीन्महाशब्दो भीरूणां भयवर्धनः॥
en: Then as the princes were being slaughtered by Abhimanyu, they created a loud noise enhancing the apprehension of the cowards by calling one another by their names.

sa: रथनागाश्वमनुजानर्दयन् निशितैः शरैः। सम्प्रविश्याकरोद् भूमि कबन्धगणसंकुलाम्॥
en: Breaking through the hostije array, he began to afflict car-warriors, elephant-riders, horse-men and infantry with his great arrows; and thus made the earth impassable with headless trunks.

sa: ग्राम्याणां पुरुषाः श्रेष्ठाः सिंहाश्चारण्यवासिनाम्। सर्वेषामेव भूतानामन्योन्येनोपजीवनम्॥
en: Among creatures that are domestic man is the foremost; lions are the foremost of all wild animals. All creatures keep themselves up by living upon one another.

sa: भीष्मं जहि महाबाहो यत्कृते दुःखमीदृशम्। प्राप्ताहं भृगुशार्दूल चराम्यप्रियमुत्तमम्॥
en: Slay Bhishma, O you of long arms, for it is by his doings that I am fallen into such distress, O you foremost among the race of Bhrigu, and that I continue in this growing distress.

sa: पुत्रात् पुण्यतरस्तुभ्यं मा पुत्रमनुतप्यथाः। अपज्वानमदाक्षिण्यमभि श्वैत्येत्युदाहरत्॥
en: And so was superior to your son, you should not lament for your son saying 'O Shvaitya' who performed no sacrifice and gave away no sacrificial presents.

sa: नटनर्तकगन्धर्वैः पूर्णकैवर्धमानकैः। नित्योद्योगैश्च क्रीडद्भिस्तत्र स्म परिहर्षिताः॥
en: They were always entertained by actors, dancers, ministrels perfectly accomplished and well-acquainted with their respective arts and engaged in sports and always striving for pleasing the former.

sa: ते शूराश्चित्रवर्माणस्तप्तकुण्डलधारिणः। आज्यावसिक्ताज्वलिताधिष्ण्येष्विव हुताशनाः॥
en: Those warriors, clad in variegated armours, and bearing golden ear-rings shone like clarified butter is poured (or them).

sa: ग्निग्धाञ्जनचयाकारं सम्प्राप्तः कालपर्वतम्। ब्रह्मतुङ्गं नदीश्चान्यास्तथा जनपदानपि॥
en: He then arrived at the black mountains that looked like a heap of collyrium and after that, at the Brahmatunga, at many rivers and at many countries.

sa: हेमरूप्यमयैः शृङ्गै नौषधिविदीपितान्। तथा मन्दारवृक्षेश्च पुष्पितैरुपशोभितान्॥
en: The mountain itself was graced with gold and silver peaks blazing with various herbs and Oshadhis; and it was beautiful with numerous Mandara trees decked with blossoms.

sa: प्रेक्षमाणो बहून् भावाञ्जगामाद्भुतदर्शनान्। उदीच्यां दिशि धर्मात्मासोऽपश्यच्छ्वेतपर्वतम्॥
en: It seemed that he saw, as he went, many wonderful sight and objects; that one of righteous soul then saw on the Northern direction the white mountain.

sa: ततो जघ्नुर्महाभेरीः शतशश्च सहस्रशः। शङ्खाश्च गोक्षीरनिभान् दध्मुर्हष्टा मनस्विनः॥
en: to Those greatly powerful also ordered hundreds and hundreds of large drums and Pushkaras to be sounded and thousands and thousands of conchs all as white as the milk of the cows to be loudly blown.

sa: स प्रजानुग्रहं कृत्वा त्रिदशैरभिपूजितः॥
en: In consequence of his showing mercy towards his subjects he used to be honoured by the celestials themselves.

sa: युध्यन्तौ कृपवार्ष्णेयौ येऽपश्यश्चित्रयोधिनौ। ते युद्धासक्तमनसो नान्यां बुबुधिरे क्रियाम्॥
en: Then those that saw Kripa and him of the Vrishni race-the heroes accomplished in various modes of warfare-engaged in battle with each other, became absorbed in that encounter and they could attend to no other action.

sa: शरैरग्निसमस्पर्शेराकर्णसमचोदितैः। स गाढविद्धो व्यथितो रथोपस्थ उपाविशत्॥
en: Thus deeply pierced and painted to the extreme, Dushasana squatted down on the terrace of his chariot and, O mighty monarch, he became unconscious in a swoon.

sa: तामवप्लुत्य जग्राह विकोशं चाकरोदसिम्। वैनतेयो यथा कार्ष्णिः पतन्तमुरगोत्तमम्॥
en: Then like the son of Vinata catching hold of a mighty falling snake, the nephew of Krishna, leaping up caught hold of the dart; and having caught it, he drew his sword out of its sheathe.

sa: शस्त्रौघमक्षय्यमभिप्रवृद्धं यदावगाह्य श्रमनष्टचेताः। भविष्यसि त्वं हतसर्वबान्धवस्तदा मनस्ते परितापमेष्यति॥
en: Jayadratha its hidden rocks, Purumitra its depth, Shakuni its water falls. when descending into the sea having inexhaustible weapons as its waves you will feel weary and be rendered senseless, then will your mind feel repentance.

sa: सोऽस्तूयत पुरा हृष्टैः सूतमागधबन्दिभिः। सोऽद्य क्रव्याद्गणैधौरैर्विनदद्भिपास्यते॥
en: He who formerly used to be eulogised by the joyful bards, minstrels and singers alas, he, today, is greeted by the dreadful flesh-eaters with their fierce yells!

sa: पूर्वमुक्तोऽहमनया गङ्गातीरेऽहमाश्रमान्। पश्येयमिति तस्याश्च कामः संवर्त्यतामयम्॥
en: Ere this Sītā had communicated her intention of beholding the hermitages of ascetics on the banks of the Gangā. Let that desire of hers be now satisfied.

sa: अपीत्वैवाऽमृतं पक्षी परिगृह्याशुनिःसृतः। आगच्छदपरिश्रान्त आवार्यार्कप्रभां ततः॥
en: He soon came out, but he did not drink the Ambrosia. He then proceeded on his way without the least fatigue, darkening the splendour of the sun.

sa: कूपारामसभावाप्यो ब्राह्मणावसथास्तथा। बभूवुः सर्वर्द्धियुतास्तस्मिन् राष्ट्रे सदोत्सवाः॥
en: The wells were full of water, the groves abounded with trees, the houses of Brahmanas were full of wealth and the whole kingdom was full of prosperity.

sa: अव्याहरन्क्वचित्किचिनिश्चेष्टो निःसुखः पथि। निर्जगाम गृहात्तस्माद्दीप्यमानो यथांशुमान्॥
en: Having given up all actions of senses, and suffered the pains of going on foot he issued out of the city speechless like to the burning sun.

sa: साहं त्वामभिषेकार्थमवतीर्णं समुद्रगाम्। दृष्टैव पुरुषव्याघ्र कन्दर्पणाभिमूर्छिता॥
en: O best of men, seeing you descend into the river in order to perform your ablutions, I was deprived of my senses by the god of love.

sa: दृष्ट्वा सूतं मेनिरे पाण्डुपुत्रा भित्त्वा नीतं लक्ष्यवरं धरायाम्। धनुर्धरा रागकृतप्रतिज्ञमत्यग्निसोमार्कमथार्कपुत्रम्॥
en: Seeing the son of Surya, Karna of the Suta tribe, who was like a fire or moon or the sun, resolved to shoot the mark, those foremost of bowmen, the Pandavas, considered that the mark had already been shot and brought down to the ground.

sa: युधिष्ठिराभ्यनुज्ञातास्ते नृपा हृष्टमानसाः। जग्मुः स्वेदशास्त्वरिता यानरुच्चावचैस्ततः॥
en: Having been commanded by Yudhishthira, those kings with joyful hearts and without any further loss of time started on their excellent vehicles for their own respective kingdoms.

sa: जानन्त्यप्यतुलं वीर्यमाशीर्वादपरायणा। प्रीता परमदुःखार्ता नागैविप्रकृता सती॥
en: Sauti said: Though she knew the matchless strength of her son, yet being exceedingly sorrowful and gentle and deceived by the Nagas, Vinata heartily blessed him, (saying)

sa: विस्तीर्णा योजनशतं शतमध्यर्धमायता। वैहायसी कामगमा पञ्चयोजनमुच्छ्रिता॥
en: Its breadth is one hundred Yojanas, its length is also one hundred and fifty Yojanas; it is five Yojanas in height. It can go anywhere at will.

sa: कच्चिद् वैद्याश्चिकित्सायामष्टाङ्गायां विशारदाः। सुहृदश्चानुरक्ताश्च शरीरे ते हिताः सदा॥
en: The physicians that have been appointed by you to look after your health are surely learned in the eight divisions of the science of treatment)? They are surely all attached to you and devoted to you?

sa: दिदृक्षुस्तत्र तमृषि तपोराशिमथाव्ययम्। ब्रह्मलोकप्रतीकाशमाश्रमं सोऽभिवीक्ष्य ह। षट्पदोद्गीतसंघुष्टं नानाद्विजगणायुतम्॥
en: He desired to see that Rishi who was an indestructible mass of ascetic merit. He saw that the hermitage was like the region of Brahma. Bees were sweetly buzzing and birds were pouring forth their melodies.

sa: कौन्तेयस्त्वर्जुनो राजन्नेकलव्यमनुस्मरन्। रहो द्रोणं समासाद्य प्रणयादिदमब्रवीत्॥
en: O king, the son of Kunti, Arjuna thinking of Ekalavya all the while, saw Drona in private and relying upon his preceptor's love for him he said-

sa: दुर्योधनस्य जननी जज्ञातेऽर्थविशारदौ। कृष्णद्वैपायनाज्जज्ञे धृतराष्ट्रो जनेश्वरः॥
en: Who became the mother of Duryodhana and both of them were well versed in acquiring worldly profits. From Krishna Dvaipayana was born Dhritarashtra, the king of men.

sa: ते त्वगच्छन्नहोरात्रात् तीर्थं सोमाश्रयायणम्। आसेदुः पुरुषव्याघ्रा गङ्गायां पाण्डुनन्दनाः॥
en: Those best of men, the sons of Pandu, came to (the banks of) the Ganges. The great car-warriors Dhananjaya (Arjuna) walked before, carrying torch in his hand for showing them the way and for protecting them.

sa: भरतस्यान्वये जातं शान्तनोश्च यशस्विनः। कुन्तिभोजात्मजापुत्रं को बुभूषेत नार्जुनम्॥
en: Who is there that would not desire to have Arjuna as a friend? He is born in the race of Bharata and the illustrious Shantanu and he is also the son of the daughter of Kuntibhoja.

sa: अर्हस्त्वमसि धर्मज्ञ राजसूयं महाक्रतुम्। अथैवमुक्ते नृपतावृत्विग्भिर्ऋषिभिस्तथा॥
en: "O king, learned in the precepts of virtue, you are worthy of performing the great sacrifice of Rajasuya.” When the Ritvijas and the Rishis told these words.

sa: एवंविधाश्चाप्यपरे देवकल्पा महारथाः। जाता मनोरन्ववाये ऐलवंशविवर्धनाः॥
en: In this way were born in the race of Manu, many mighty car-warriors like the celestials themselves and who by their number greatly increased the Aila dynasty.

sa: तेषां संघर्षजश्चाग्निरर्चिभि: प्रज्वलन्मुहुः। विद्युद्भिरिव नीलाभ्रमावृणोन्मन्दरं गिरिम्॥
en: And great fires were produced from the mutual friction of the trees that frequently blazed up and the Mandara mountain looked like black clouds charged with lightning,

sa: येनाभिषिक्तो नृपतिर्वारुणं गुणमृच्छति। तेन राजापि तं कृत्स्नं सम्राङ्गुणमभीप्सति॥
en: The Ministers said A king already in possession of a kingdom wishes to acquire all the attributes of an emperor by means of the sacrifice, (Rajasuya) a sacrifice that helps to acquire the attributes of Varuna.

sa: तथैवाशिरसो राजन्नृक्षवक्त्राश्च भारत। प्रदीप्तनेत्रजिह्वाश्च ज्वालावर्णास्तथैव च।॥
en: And some, O king, had no heads, and some had faces like those of bears. The eyes of some were like fire, and some had fiery features.

sa: स्थूलोदरा: कृशाङ्गाश्च स्थूलाङ्गाश्च कृशोदराः॥ ह्रस्वग्रीवा महाकर्णा नानाव्यालविभूषणाः। नकुलोलूकवकनाश्च काकवक्त्रास्तथा परे। आखुबभ्रुकवकनाश्च मयूरवदनास्तथा॥ गजेन्द्रचर्मवसनास्तथा कृष्णाजिनाम्बराः॥ स्कन्धेमुखा महाराज तथाप्युदरतोमुखाः। पृष्ठेमुखा हनुमुखास्तथा जङ्घामुखा अपि॥ पार्थाननाश्च बहवो नानादेशमुखास्तथा। तथा कीटपतङ्गानां सदृशास्या गणेश्वराः॥ नानाव्यालमुखाश्चान्ये बहुबाहुशिरोधराः।
en: Some had large and protruding stomachs but other limbs very lean; some had large limbs but lean stomachs. The necks of some were very short and the ears of some were very Jarge. Some had various kinds of snakes for their ornaments. Some were clad in skins of large elephants. And some in black deer-skins. The mouths of some were on their shoulders. Some had mouths on their stomachs, some on their backs, some on their cheeks, some on their calves and some on their flanks and the mouths of many were placed on other parts of their bodies. The faces of some amongst those combatants were like those of insects and worms. The mouths of some amongst them were like those of various beasts of prey. Some had many arms and some many heads.

sa: न हि वैक्लव्यसंसृष्टमानृशंस्यमिहास्थितः। प्रजापालनसम्भूतमाप्ता धर्मफलं ह्यसि॥
en: Never be affected by anxiety, and never adopt such inoffensive conduct. By becoming so, you would not earn that merit of righteousness which arises from protecting subjects.

sa: अदान्तो ब्राह्मणोऽसाधुनिस्तेजाः क्षत्रियोऽधमः। अदक्षो निन्द्यते वैश्यः शूद्रश्च प्रतिकूलवान्॥
en: Hence a Brahmana without self-restraint is an object of censure. A Kshatriya who has no energy is mean. A Vaishya without skill is an object of blame, as also a Shudra who is void of humility.

sa: हयपत्तिलताकीर्णं गाहमानो महायशाः। व्यचरत्तत्र गोविन्दो रथेनातिपताकिना॥
en: Cavalry and infantry were its creepers. And the illustrious Keshava, as he entered that forest on that car adorned with many banners and pennons, shone exceedingly resplendent.

sa: तस्मादिह कृतप्रज्ञास्त्यागं न परिचक्षते। धर्मव्यतिक्रमं चैव मन्यन्ते सूक्ष्मदर्शिनः॥
en: Wise men, therefore, do not praise Renunciation as the duty of a Kshatriya. On the other hand, the clear-sighted think that the adoption of such a life (by a Kshatriya) involves even the loss of virtue.

sa: ततः क्रौझं महामन्युः क्रौञ्चनादनिनादितम्। शक्त्या विभेद भगवान् कार्तिकेयोऽग्निदत्तया॥
en: Worked up with ire, the worshipful Kartikeya then pierced that mountain with that dart given him by Agni. The mountain was called Krauncha (crane). for the sound it always produced resembled the cry of a crane.

sa: भविष्यति हि ते पुत्रः क्रूरकर्मात्यमर्षणः॥ उत्पत्स्यति च ते भ्राता ब्रह्मभूतस्तपोरतः।
en: You have been imposed upon by your mother, O blessed lady, by the substitution of the sanctified food. Your son will become a man of cruel deeds and vindictive heart. Your brother again (born of your mother) will be Brahmana ever devoted to ascetic penances.

sa: तस्मादध्वानमेवैतमाहुः शास्त्रविदो जनाः। यत्तु संसारगहनं वनमाहुर्मनीषिणः॥
en: Men well read in scriptures, describe for this life's course as a long way. The wise also describe life's way with all its difficulties as a forest.

sa: भूरिदक्षिणमिक्ष्वाकुं यजमानं भगीरथम्। त्रिलोकपथगा गङ्गा दुहितृत्वमुपेयुषी॥
en: The Ganga who had three courses had agreed to be the daughter of Bhagiratha of Ikshvaku's race, race, who always celebrated sacrifices with enough presents the Brahmanas.

sa: सर्वोपायै रणमुखमातिष्ठंस्त्यक्तजीवितः। प्राप्नोतीन्द्रस्य सालोक्यं शूरः पृष्ठमदर्शयन्॥
en: The hero, by not retreating from battle and fighting by every means in his power, careless of life itself, at the van of battle, lives with Indra.

sa: युवा श्यामो लोहिताक्षो मातङ्ग इव यूथपः। आजानुबाहुः सुमुखः सिंहस्कन्धो महाभुजः॥
en: Youthful and having a dark complexion, and red eyes, he looked like the leader of an elephantine herd. With arms extending down to his knees and of beautiful face, his shoulders were like those of a lion and the power of his arms was great.

sa: मोक्षस्यास्ति त्रिवर्गोऽन्यः प्रोक्तः सत्त्वं रजस्तमः। स्थानं वृद्धिः क्षयश्चैव त्रिवर्गश्चैव दण्डजः॥
en: The three-fold characteristics of liberation according to the attributes of Goodness, Darkness and Ignorance and another namely the performance of duty without the desire for fruits were also described in it. Another threefold characteristics of Punishment viz., Conservation, Growth, and Destruction, were treated in it.

sa: संक्षोभ्य सलिलं वेगाद् गदामादाय वीर्यवान्। अद्रिसारमयीं गुर्वी काञ्चनाङ्गदभूषणाम्॥
en: Agitating the waters with great force that brave warrior rose like a prince of elephants from within the lake, sighing heavily in rage and armed with his heavy and strong mace of adamant decked with gold.

sa: श्रेयश्च यदि जानीषे क्रियतां मा विचारय॥
en: I am pleased with you, O amiable one! Blessed be you who wish me to live! Do that, without hesitation, which you think would do us good.

sa: सकृत्पाशावकीर्णास्ते न भविष्यन्ति दुर्दमाः। उचितेनैव भोक्तव्यास्ते भविष्यन्ति यत्नतः॥
en: If the reins are thus put, they would not refuse to to bear them. Indeed, sufficient measures should be taken for making them obedient. Mere entreaties to bring them to subjection would be of no avail.

sa: वैन्यस्ततस्तानुवाच देवानृषिपुरोगमान्। ब्राह्मणा महाभागा नमस्याः पुरुषर्षभः॥
en: Thus addressed, Vena's son replied to the deities headed by the Rishis, saying,-Those foremost of men, viz., the highly blessed Brahmanas shall ever be adored by me,

sa: यथा वै ब्राह्मणः सीदन्नयाज्यमपि याजयेत्। अभोज्यानानि चाश्नीयात् तथेदं नात्र संशयः॥
en: Even as a Brahmana in a time of distress may officiate at the sacrifice of a person for whom he should never officiate and eat forbidden food, so there is no doubt that a Kshatriya may take riches from every one say ascetics and Brahmanas.

sa: अत्रैवोदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्॥ संजयं पुत्रशोकार्तं यथायं नारदोऽब्रवीत्।
en: Regarding it is cited the old discourse of Narada before Srinjaya when the latter was greatly stricken with grief on account of the death of his sons.

sa: स मुनिस्तस्य विज्ञाय भावज्ञो भयकारणम्। रुतज्ञः सर्वसत्त्वानां तमैश्वर्यसमन्वितः॥
en: Reading the thoughts of all creatures, the sage felt that the dog had sufficient cause for fear. Endued with the six attributes and capable of reading the voices of all animals, the sage said as follows.

sa: भाण्डागारायुधागारं प्रयत्नेनाभिवर्धयेत्। निचयान् वर्धयेत् सर्वांस्तथा यन्त्रायुधालयान्॥
en: He should collect provisions of all sorts and replenish his arsenals carefully. He should also increase his storage of rice and other grain, and strengthen his counsels.

sa: ऋषींस्तानभिवाद्याथ पार्श्वे हिमवतोऽच्युतः॥ संध्याकार्याणि सर्वाणि निर्वारुरुहेऽचलम्।
en: Bidding a farewell to the Rishis, Baladeva performed all the rites and ceremonies of the evening on the side of Himavat and then began to ascend mountain.

sa: नदीगतमदीनात्मा प्राप्तो विनशनं तदा॥
en: Beholding Upadana and and praising it repeatedly, Baladeva next proceeded to Vinashana which also was on the Sarasvati.

sa: शुश्रूषुः श्रुतवाश्रोता ऊहापोहविशारदः॥ मेधावी धारणायुक्तो यथान्यायोपपादकः। दान्तः सदा प्रियाभाषी क्षमावांश्च विपर्यये॥ दानाच्छेदे स्वयंकारी श्रद्धालुः सुखदर्शनः। आर्तहस्तप्रदो नित्यमाप्तामात्यो नये रतः॥ नाहंवादी न निर्द्वन्द्वो न यत्किचनकारकः। कृते कर्मण्यमात्यानां कर्ता भृत्यजनप्रियः॥
en: He should be patient, forgiving, of pure conduct, severe when necessity requires it, know the virtues of manliness, respectful towards his elder, possessed of a knowledge of the scriptures, ready to listen to the instructions and advice of competent men, capable of judging correctly from amongst the various course of action suggested to him, intelligent, of a retentive memory, ready to do what is just, self-controlled, always sweet-speeched, forgiving even to enemies, practising charity personally, possessed of faith, of lovely features, ready to help distressed persons, having ministers who always seek his wellbeing, free from egoism, never without a wife, and undisposed to do anything hastily. He should always reward his ministers when they perform anything great. He should love those wh

sa: सोऽब्रवीत्परमप्रीतो मान्धाता राजसत्तमम्। वसुहोमं महाप्राज्ञमासीनं कुरुनन्दन॥
en: Thus addressed, O delighter of the Kurus, Mandhatri, that best of kings, highly pleased, answered the greatly wise Vasuhoma seated at his ease, in the following words.

sa: अहःसु सततं तिष्ठेदभ्याकाशं निशां स्वपन्। त्रिरह्नि त्रिर्निशायां च सवासा जलमाविशेत्॥
en: He should during the day be under shelter of the sky and should sleep in the same way at night, thrice during the day, and thrice during the night, he should also plunge with the clothes into a river or lake for performing his ablutions.

sa: नदी मधुरपानीया यथा राजंस्तथा भवान्। श्वगृध्रगोमायुयुतो राजहंससमो ह्यसि॥
en: You resemble, O king, a river full of sweet water but difficult of access, with steep banks overgrown with Kariras and thorny canes. You are like a swan in the midst of dogs, vultures, and jackals.

sa: प्रगण्डीः कारयेत् सम्यगाकाशजननीस्तदा। आपूरयेच्च परिखां स्थाणुनक्रझषाकुलाम्॥
en: He should erect outer ramparts round his forts, and fill his trenches with water, putting pointed stakes at their bottom and filling them with crocodiles and sharks.

sa: इत्येवमुक्त्वा विरराम शल्यो दुर्योधनं शोकपरीतचेताः। मार्त विसंज्ञं भृशमश्रुनेत्रम्॥
en: Addressing these words to Duryodhana, Shalya, with an aggrieved heart, stopped. Duryodhana too, greatly moved and beside himself with sorrow, with tears running down his eyes, wept for the charioteer's son crying "O Karna, O Karna!"

sa: पुत्रशोकाभितप्तेन प्रतिज्ञां चाभिरक्षता। पाकशासनिना संख्ये वार्धक्षत्रिनिपातितः॥
en: Burning with grief on account of the death of his son, and desirous of fulfilling his vow, Indra's son Arjuna has killed there that son of Vriddhakshatra.

sa: कालं सर्वेशमकरोत् संहारविनयात्मकम्। मृत्योश्चतुर्विभागस्य दुःखस्य च सुखस्य च॥
en: Time, containing the seeds of both origin and destruction was made the lord of all creatures, as also of the four parts of Death viz., weapons, diseases, Yama, and acts, and, lastly of grief and joy.

sa: जातकर्मादिकास्तत्र क्रियाश्चक्रे बृहस्पतिः। वेदश्चैनं चतुर्मूर्तिरुपतस्थे कृताञ्जलिः॥
en: The celestial priest Brihaspati performed the usual rites consequent upon the birth, of that child. The Vedas, assuming a fourfold form, approached the child with clasped hands.

sa: ऋत्विकपुरोहिताचार्यान् सत्कृतानभिसत्कृतान्। न ब्राह्मणान् घातयीत दोषान् प्राप्नोति घातयन्॥
en: At such times, however, the king should not oppress Ritwijas, Purohitas preceptors and Brahmanas, all of whom are respected and held in high esteem. By oppressing them, even at such times, he incurs blame and sin.

sa: सीतां पद्मपलाशाक्षी मन्मथस्य रतिं यथा। इष्टां सर्वस्य जगतः पूर्णचन्द्रप्रभामिव ॥ भूमौ सुतनुमासीनां नियतामिव तापसीम्। निःश्वासबहुलां भीरुं भुजगेन्द्रवधूमिव ॥
en: She had eyes resembling lotus petals and was like the beloved wife of Manmatha-Rati and was adorable to the whole creation like the rays of the full-moon. That one having a graceful person was seated on the earth like a female ascetic having her senses restrained. And she was sighing again and again like the timid daughterin-law of the lord of serpents.* *The epithet has a special significance because through her the destruction of the race of Raksasas was brought about.

sa: शरैरतिमहावेगैर्वेगवान्रावणात्मजः। सौमित्रिमिन्द्रजिद्युद्धे विव्याध शुभलक्षणम्॥
en: In that encounter, Rāvana's son-Indrajit, possessed of eminent impetuosity, pierced Laksmana, graced with auspicious marks, with vehement shafts.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु सौमित्रिरभ्यषिञ्चद्विभीषणम्। मध्ये वानरमुख्यानां राजानं राजशासनात्॥
en: Being thus addressed, Saumitri, at the command of the king, anointed Vibhișana and made him the king of the Räkşasas in the presence of the monkey host.

sa: ततः पारे समुद्रस्य गदापाणिविभीषणः॥ परेषामभियानार्थमतिष्ठत्सचिवैः सह।
en: Then on the other shore of the ocean, Bibhisbana with the view of opposing foes (that might advance), stationed himself mace in hand, along with some councilors.

sa: वृतो हि बाह्वन्तरभोगराशिश्चिन्ताविषः सुस्मिततीक्ष्णदंष्ट्रः। पञ्चाङ्गुलीपञ्चशिरोऽतिकायः सौतामहाहिस्तव केन राजन्॥
en: You have been bound about your neck by the mighty and huge serpent, Sītā, having her breast for its body anxiety for its venom, smile for its sharp fangs, and her five fingers for its hood.

sa: निरुच्छासा हताः केचित्केचित्पार्श्वेषु दारिताः। केचिद्विभिन्नशिरसः केचिच्चक्षुर्विनाकृताः॥
en: Some had their breath choked, some were killed and others had their sides broken. Some had their hands cut off and others had their eyes put out.

sa: पार्श्वेषु दारिताः केचित्केचिद्राशीकृता दुमैः। शिलाभिश्चूर्णिताः केचित्केचिद्दन्तैर्विदारिताः॥
en: And some were severed along their flanks; and, some, slain with trees, were heaped up; and some were crushed with crags; and some were torn with teeth.

sa: पुरा शरत्सूर्यमरीचिसंनिभान् नवाग्रपुङ्खान्सुदृढानृपात्मजः। सृजत्यमोघान्विशिखान्वधाय ते प्रदीयतां दाशरथाय मैथिली।॥
en: Ere yet the king's son, for compassing your destruction, shower sure shafts resembling the rays of the autumnal Sun, having shining heads and feathered parts, and exceedingly hard, do you render Maithili to son of Daſaratha.

sa: एतनिमित्तं वैदेही भयं नः सुमहद्भवेत्। आहता सा परित्याज्या कलहार्थे कृते नु किम्॥
en: It is for this great fear that exercise us on the score of Vaidehi owing its existence to this,* that she, having been ravished, should (now) be given up. What is the use of acting so that quarrel may be the consequence? *The feeling of revenge for the slaughter of Khara and the rest.

sa: तुल्यशीलवयोवृत्तां तुल्याभिजनलक्षणाम्। राघवोऽर्हति वैदेहीं तं चेयमसितेक्षणा॥
en: As regards their character, age, conduct, family and other auspicious marks they are equal and hence Rāghava deserve Vaidehi and this one of dark-blue eyes is his.

sa: तान्गृहीतायुधान्सर्वान्वारयित्वा विभीषणः। अब्रवीत्प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यं पुनः प्रत्युपवेश्य तान्।७।।
en: Then, preventing them, who had (thus) equipped themselves with all kinds of weapons, and making them sit down, Vibhisana, with joined hands, again spoke to them, saying.

sa: चलकुण्डलमौलिस्रक्तपनीयविभूषणः। पादयोन्य॑पतद्वायुस्त्रिरुपस्थाय वेधसे ॥
en: Thrice the Vāyu prostrated before the Brahma with swinging ear-rings, illustrious diadem, garland and ornament of the gold,

sa: व्यथिताः पन्नगाश्चासन्दीप्तास्या दीप्तलोचनाः। दानवाश्च महावीर्याः पातालतलवासिनः॥
en: The serpents were distressed, with their faces flaming and their eyes aglow; as well as the Dānavas of terrific energy, and the dwellers of the nether spheres.

sa: प्राप्तभूयिष्ठपारस्तु सर्वतः परिलोकयन्। योजनानां शतस्यान्ते वनराजी ददर्श सः॥
en: And it came to pass that as he had almost arrived at the other shore (of the ocean), he looking about on all sides at the end of an hundred yojanas saw a range of woods.

sa: स शरैभिन्नसर्वाङ्गो गात्रप्रमुतशोणितः। राक्षसेन्द्रसमूहस्थः फुल्लाशोक इवाबभौ॥
en: Thereat with all his limbs pierced (with arrows), and his body laved in blood, the lord of Räkşasas furnished with many limbs, looked like a flowering Asoka.

sa: स्वकृतैर्हन्यमानस्य रावणादीर्घदर्शिनः। अभिनन्दन्ति भूतानि विनाशे पापकर्मणः॥
en: O Rāvana, every one delight in the destruction of that inconsiderate being, who bring about his own destruction and is engaged in the perpetration of evil deeds.

sa: सहामीभिस्त्वया लङ्का निर्जिता राक्षसेश्वरः। हृष्टैः प्राणभयं त्यक्त्वा संग्रामेष्वनिवर्तिभिः॥
en: With these and you, I conquered the city of Lanka, O lord of Raksasas. They all fought with a delighted heart, having renounced all fear of life and who did never go away from the battlefield.

sa: नानिमित्तोऽभवद्वाणो नानिर्भेत्ता न निष्फलः॥ अन्योन्यमभिसंहत्य निपेतुर्धरणीतले। तथा विसृजतोर्बाणान्रामरावणयोर्मधे॥
en: None (of the arrows) missed the aim, none of them failed to pierce another and none of them was fruitless. And the arrows discharged by Rāma and Rāvana striking each other fell down on the earth.

sa: सहस्रबाहोस्तद्युद्धं विंशद्वाहोश्च दारुणम्। नृपराक्षसयोस्तत्र आरब्धं रोमहर्षणम्॥
en: Thereupon there ensued a terrible encounter capable of making down erect between the thousand-armed Arjuna, the king of men, and the twenty-armed Ravana, the king of Raksasas.

sa: स्फोटयन्निव शब्देन लङ्कां साट्टालगोपुराम्॥ सहेन्द्रेणेव देवानां नादः समभवन्महान्॥
en: The noise set up by the delighted monkeys like to a dreadful leonine roar, as if rending the city of Lankā abounding in edifices and gates, resembled the great roar of the celestials along with Indra.

sa: समीक्ष्यापततस्तांस्तु वानरेन्द्रान्महाबलान्। आववार शरौघेण नगेनेव जलाशयम्॥
en: Seeing them spring forward; he covered up those exceedingly mighty lords of monkey, with showers of shafts, even as a crag obstruct the course of a current.

sa: स्वयंभुवा ब्राह्मममोघवीर्यम्। तन्मानयन्तौ युधि राजपुत्रौ निपातितौ कोऽत्र विषादकालः।४।।
en: On him the self-sprung has conferred the mighty Brahmă weapon of unfailing power; and the king's sons are doing honour to it by lying down on the field of battle. Why then do you grieve now?

sa: ततस्तैबहुभिवीरैर्वानरैर्वानरर्षभाः। संरक्तनयनैः क्रोधाद्धरयः संप्रधर्षिताः॥
en: They were greatly assailed by those many thousand heroic monkeys, worked up with ire and having reddened eyes.

sa: ततस्त्विन्द्रजिता लङ्का सूर्यप्रतिमतेजसा। रराजाप्रतिवीर्येण द्यौरिवार्केण भास्वता॥
en: With Indrajit furnished with the splendour of the Sun himself, and possessed of peerless prowess, Lankā looked beauteous even as the firmament graced with the glorious Sun.

sa: तान्यायताक्षाण्यगसंनिभानि प्रदीप्तवैश्वानरलोचनानि। पेतुः शिरांसीन्द्ररिपोः पृथिव्यां ज्योतींषि मुक्तानि यथेन्द्रमार्गात्॥
en: Thereat even as burning stars, loosened, drop down from the course of Indra, the large organs of sense, and eyes flaming like glowing fire, and heads of that foe of Indra, dropped down to the ground.

sa: तद्रामवचनं सर्वमन्यूनाधिकमुत्तमम्। सामात्यं श्रावयामास निवेद्यात्मानमात्मना ॥
en: Then introducing himself, Angada delivered to Rāvana along with his ministers all that Rama had excellently spoken to him, neither extenuating nor setting down aught of himself.

sa: न शेकुरश्वाः संस्थातुं विमदाः कुञ्जराभवन्। स्यन्दनेभ्यश्च्युता वीराः शङ्खरावितदुर्बलाः॥
en: Thereat the horses could not keep their ground, and the elephants were reſt of their temporal flow, and shorn of their virtue at the roars of the conch, heroes began to topple down from their cars.

sa: वीरपार्थिवपत्नीनां ये विदुर्भर्तृपूजिताम्। तेऽद्य सर्वे हते रामे ज्ञानिनोऽनृतवादिनः॥
en: They also asserted that I should be honoured of the wives of heroic kings as well as of my lord, but on Rāma being slain, they seem to have spoken a falsehood, although possessed of knowledge.

sa: अनन्यहृदयां सीतां मच्चित्तपरिरक्षिणीम्। अहमप्यवगच्छामि मैथिली जनकात्मजाम्॥
en: I know it full well that Maithili, the daughter of king Janaka, has her mind devoted to me and has not given it to any one (else).

sa: नेदुरास्फोटयामासुश्चिक्षिपुस्ते निशाचराः। कुम्भकर्णविबोधार्थं चक्रुस्ते विपुलं स्वरम्॥
en: The night-rangers shouted and struck at their arms with their hands and began to pull him. And for rousing Kumbhakarņa, mighty was the din that they raised.

sa: क्षुरप्रेण धनुस्तस्य चिच्छेद तनयस्तव। अथैनं दशभिर्बाणैश्छिन्नधन्वानमार्दयत्॥
en: Your son, then) with (great) nimbleness of hand cut-off his bow with a razor-shaped arrow and then smote that one whose bow was cutoff, with ten darts.

sa: ततो घटोत्कचो बाणैर्दशभिर्गौतमीसुतम्। जघानोरसि संक्रुद्धो विषाग्निप्रतिमैदृद्वैः॥
en: Then Ghatatkacha, excited with, anger struck the son of the daughter of Goutama on the chest with ten strong arrows (fierce) like the venom or the fire.

sa: रराज वसुधा कीर्णा विसर्पद्भिरिवोरगैः॥ क्षिप्तैः काञ्चनदण्डैश्च नृपच्छत्रैः क्षितिर्बभौ।
en: The earth being strewn it looked as beautiful as if strewn around with moving snakes; with golden staves cut (to pieces) and royal umbrellas (lying scattered all over the field of battle) the earth looked like.

sa: वार्धक्षेमिर्महाराज समुद्र इव पर्वणि॥ आयुध्क्षयमासाद्य प्रशान्तिं परमां गतः।
en: O great king, when all his weapons were exhausted, Vardhakshemi obtained in the end the superior kind of peace, even as the ocean at full tide becomes peaceful after its (superfluous) water has been drained up.

sa: शरजालैः समाकीर्णे मेघजालैरिवाम्बरे। नापतच ततः कश्चिदन्तरिक्षचरस्तदा॥
en: The firmament being covered with networks of arrows, as if with masses of clouds, no ranger of the air was then seen to course through it. more

sa: पीड्यमानेषु लोकेषु ततः शक्रो मरुवृतः॥ पुराण्यायोधयांचक्रे वज्रपातैः समन्ततः।
en: While thus all the worlds were very greatly oppressed (by the Danavas), then Shakra (Indra), who had been encompassed by all the Maruts, fought against those cities by hurling his thunder (upon them) from all sides.

sa: अस्त्रौघान्महतो मुक्तौ द्रोणहार्दिक्यरक्षितात्। राच्मानावदृश्येतामिन्द्राग्न्योः सदृशौ रणे॥
en: Escaping from those thick down-pours of arrows, from those divisions protected by Drona and Hridika's son, Keshava and Arjuna appeared like Indra and Agni of burning radiance.

sa: श्चरन्तमुग्रं प्रतिबाधनाय॥ प्रयच्छान्यस्मै गाण्डिवमेदद्य त्वत्तो योऽस्त्रैरभ्यधिको वा नरेन्द्रः।
en: If you are unable to resist the fearful Karna in his march on the field today, then do make over this your Gandiva to any other king who is your superior in the use of weapons.

sa: तं मामेवंविधं राजन् समर्थमरिनिग्रह॥ कस्माद् युनसि सारथ्ये नीचस्याधिरथे रणे। ह्यभ्युगतं
en: Why do you, O king, being conscious of the fact that I am thus capable of striking down the enemies, employ me to the office of the charioteer in the field of battle to the son of Adhiratha, who is born of such low parentage.

sa: ततस्तु सारथिख़त्वा द्रोणपुत्रमचेतनम्। अपोवाह रणाद् राजन् सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः॥
en: Thereupon, O king, his driver having been conscious of the insensible condition of the son of Drona, carried him away from the field of battle in the presence of all his (the son of Drona) soldiers.

sa: नृत्यन्तं रथमार्गेषु धनुर्ध्यातलनिःस्वनैः। संग्रामकोविदं पार्थ सर्वे युद्धविशारदाः॥ अभीताः पर्यवर्तन्त व्यादितास्यमिवान्तकम्। सैन्धवं पृष्ठतः कृत्वा जिघांसन्तोऽच्युतार्जुनौ॥
en: Then all those combatants skilled in fighting, placing the ruler Sindhus at their back and impelled by a desire for slaying Arjuna and Krishna, dauntlessly surrounded Partha, that hero versed in all modes of warfare., who then appeared to dance in the terrace of this chariot, emitting fierce sounds, with his bow-string and his palms and resembling the Destroyer himself with mouth agape.

sa: देवदानवगन्धर्वास्रस्तास्त्वासन् विशाम्पते। व.थंकथाभवत् तीव्रा दृष्ट्वा तद् व्याकुलं महत्॥
en: O Ruler of men, celestials, the Danavas and the Gandharvas all became filled with fear. Seeing then that tremendous agitation in nature, they began to question one another saying, what is the cause of all this?

sa: एवमुक्त्वा हृषीकेशः शीघ्रमश्वानचोदयत्। दूरं प्रयान्तं राजानमन्वगच्छजनार्दनः॥
en: Having thus spoken, Hrishikesha urged the steeds to the best of their speed and he then followed behind the king, who had already advanced a long way.

sa: धृष्टद्युम्नमथायान्तं द्रोणस्यान्तचिकीर्षया। परिववर्महाराज पञ्चालाः पाण्डवैः सह॥
en: And as Dhristadyumna rushed against Drona, O mighty monarch, the Panchalas together with the Pandavas surrounded him, with a view to put an end to Drona's life.

sa: स वत्सदन्तं संधाय जिह्मगानलसंनिभम्॥ आकृष्य राजन्नाकर्णाद् विव्याधोरसि सात्यकिम्।
en: Placing a Vatsadantha, capable of flying straight and resembling fire, O king, on the string of his bow, Kritavarman drew it back to his very ears and with that arrow then pierced Satyaki on the breast.

sa: ततो राजा महाप्रज्ञः सर्वास्त्रकुशलो बली। दुर्योधनऽब्रवीच्छलयं मद्रराजं महीपतिम्॥ पूरयन्निव घोषेण मेघगम्भीरया गिरा।
en: Thereupon king Duryodhana, who was very learned and versed in all objects and who also was possessed of great strength, once more addressed that ruler of earth. Shalya, the chief of the Madras, in a voice as deep as the rumbling of the clouds, filling the whole region with the echo of his voice.

sa: सर्वभूतमयंदृष्ट्वा तमजं जगतः पतिम्॥ देवा ब्रह्मर्षयश्चैव शिरोभिर्धरणीं गताः।
en: All the celestials, as well as all the regenerate sages, after having seen that embodiment of all creatures, that unborn person, who was the most supreme of the entire universe, touched the earth with their heads.

sa: हितान्युक्तानि विदुरद्रोणगाङ्गेयकेशवैः। अगृहीतान्यनुस्मृत्य कचिन्न कुरुषे व्यथाम्॥
en: The good advises, uttered (given) by Vidura, Drona, son of Ganga and Keshava, were not received by you. Do you not feel pain to remember them now?

sa: तथापि तं प्रस्फुरदात्तकार्मुकं त्रिभिः शरैर्यन्तृशिरः क्षुरेणा हयांश्चतुर्भिश्च पुनस्त्रिभिर्ध्वज धनंजयो द्रौणिरथादपातयत्॥
en: In spite of these, Dhananjaya made Drona's son carless by cutting off the out-stretched bow of his foe with three shafts, killing his driver with a razor like shaft and making away with his banner with three and his four horses with four other shafts.

sa: अथैनं छिन्नधन्वानं भग्नशृङ्गमिवर्षभम्॥ अशीत्या मार्गणैः क्रुद्धो बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्।
en: Then having been filled with rage, he struck this one (the son of Hridika), who, with his severed bow, resembled a bull with his broken horns, with eighty different arrows both in the chest and arms.

sa: सोमदत्तोऽपि तं वीरं शतेन प्रत्यविध्यता सात्वतस्त्वभिसंक्रुद्धः पुत्राधिभिरभिप्लुतम्॥ वृद्ध वृद्धगुणैयुक्तं ययातिमिव नाहुषम्। विव्याध दशभिस्तीक्ष्णैः शरैर्वज्रनिपातनैः॥
en: (Then) Sattavat, furious with wrath, struck that old one smitten with grief for the slaughter of his son (by Satyaki) and who was, like Yayati, the son of Nahusha, possessed of every noble quality, with ten sharpened arrows having the force of the thunder. After piercing him (with these ten arrows) with great mighty he (i.e. Sayiaki) struck him again with seven (more).

sa: आत्मानं रौद्रमाचष्ट रौद्रकर्मण्यधिष्ठितः। ततो रथवरान् राजन्नत्यतिक्रामदर्जुनः॥
en: And achieving wonderful feats, proclaimed himself to be a warrior of terrible deeds. Then 0 king, Arjuna passed leaving all those foremost car-warriors of your army behind.

sa: तस्य तानशनिप्रख्यानिषून् समरशोभिनः। चिच्छेद बहुभिर्भल्लैरसम्प्राप्तान् वृकोदरः॥
en: Vrikodara then cut-off with many shafts all those arrows of Karna that ornaments of battle, arrows that resembled the bolt of heaven, before they could reach him.

sa: राकर्णपूर्णैर्निशितैः सुपुजैः। विव्याध देहावरण विभिद्य ते सात्यकेराविविशुः शरीरम्॥
en: Then he pierced his adversary with three beautiful arrows resembling fire itself and furnished with golden wings, discharged from the bowstring drawn back to the very ear. These arrows penetrating through Satyaki's armour mangled his body.

sa: सूर्याचन्द्रमसौ कृत्वा चक्रे रथवरोत्तमे। पक्षौ पूर्वापरौ तत्र कृते रात्र्यहनी शुभे॥
en: The Sun and the Moon, having been made equal, were constituted to be the two other wheels of that foremost and most excellent car. The day and the night were made to be the two auspicious wings on the right and left in that car.

sa: अहोरात्रं कलाश्चैव काष्ठाश्च ऋतवस्तथा। अनुकर्षं ग्रहा दीप्ता वरुथं चापि तारकाः॥
en: The whole day and night and several other divisions of the time, namely the Kalas and Kushtas, as also the different seasons of the year constituted the Anakarsha of that car, and again the most resplendent planets and stars constituted its Varutha (the wooden fences).

sa: ततः समागमो घोरो बभूव सहसा तयोः। यथा देवासुरे युद्धे वृत्रवासवयोरिव॥
en: Then there suddenly followed a dreadful conflict between these two parties; even as there took place an encounter between Vritra even and Vashava (Indra) in the battle between the celestials and the Asuras. and Vashava (Indra) in the battle between the celestials and the Asuras.

sa: त्रातारं धार्तराष्ट्राणां गन्तारं वाहिनीमुखे। हन्तारं परसैन्यानाममित्रगणमर्दनम्॥
en: Who was the head of all the world and most celebrated car-warrior, who was the saviour of Dhritarashtra's sons and who led the van of the army;

sa: ततोऽर्जुनः प्रासृजदुग्रधन्वा भुजाबुभौ गाण्डिवं चानुमृज्य। नाराजनालीकवराहकर्णान् क्षुरांस्तथा साञ्जलिकार्धचन्द्रान्॥
en: The fierce warrior Arjuna then rubbed his bow-string with his arm and sent hosts of cloth yard shafts and arrows called Nalikas i.e. shafts headed with boar's ears and razors and Angalikas i.e. half moon-shaped arrows.

sa: एकैकं योजनशतं विस्तारायामतः समम्। गृहाट्टालकसंयुक्तं बहुप्राकारतोरणम्॥
en: Each one of them (the three cities) were measured to be one hundred yojanas broad; and contained numerous buildings and houses, as also lofty walls and perches.

sa: तमवस्थितमाज्ञाय पुत्रस्ते भरतर्षभ। विद्रुतं स्वबलं दृष्ट्वा पौरुषेण न्यवारयत्॥
en: O foremost of the Bharata race, your son having seen him staying in the field and also having witnessed his own army flaying away form the battle, forbade them run away in the most encouraging terms.

sa: प्रतिज्ञेयं कृता
en: sunset, when yourself indomitable in battle, is still alive?

sa: सुरासुरैरवध्यत्वं दत्तमस्मै स्वयंभुवा। एतच्च कवचं दिव्यं रथश्च रविभास्वरः॥
en: You shall be incapable of being slain by celestials and Asura's was the boon conferred on him by the self-sprung; and he also gave him this celestial mail and this car resembling the effulgent Sun himself.

sa: छेषस्याहं परिपश्याम्युपायम्। मुक्तो लोके प्रतितिष्ठेत साधु॥
en: I see this expiation of this dead of utter iniquity. O chief of the Kurus, your son (Duryodhana) may win by it a praise among good men.

sa: सिद्धदेवर्षिसंघाश्च चारणाश्चापि तुष्टुवुः। देवदुन्दुभयो नेदुः पुष्पवर्षाणि चापतन्॥ केशवार्जुनयोर्मूनि प्राह वाचशरोरिणी।
en: The assemblage of the Siddhas and the divine Rishis, as well as the Charanas, began to praise them highly. The celestial kettle-drums also begun to be sounded; and showers of flowers continued to fall upon the heads of both Keshava and Arjuna. Meanwhile a voice,

sa: विमुक्ता धूतपाप्मानो निर्द्वन्द्वा निष्परिग्रहाः। मानार्हा मानिता नित्यं ज्ञानविद्भिर्महात्मभिः॥
en: Shorn of altachments, purged of all sins, getting over all pairs of opposites, they are unattached to all worldly things. Deserving of every honour, they are always esteemed by persons gifted with knowledge and high souls.

sa: जयद्रथवधप्रेप्सुमायान्तं पुरुषर्षभम्। न्यवारयन्त सहिताः क्रिया व्याधिमिवोत्थितम्॥
en: Then like medicines checking a raging malady, the Kaurava warriors firmly united together began to check that foremost of men proceeding onwards for the slaughter of Jayadratha.

sa: नूनं तयोरनुमते हृदि हृच्छयचोदितः। महामेरोगिरेः शृङ्गात् प्रच्युतो गन्धमादनम्॥
en: Forsooth, with his heart given to them, and moved by a longing desire to see them, Narada dropped down on Gandhamadana from a summit of the high mountains of Meru and walked over all the world.

sa: भूमौ शये जप्यपरो दर्भेष्वजिनसंवृतः॥ नियमव्यपदेशेन गान्धारी च यशस्विनी।
en: Clad in deer-skin, I lie down on the Earth, spreading a small quantity of Kusha grass, and pass the time in silent recitations. The illustrious Gandhari, also, passes her time in the observance of similar vows.

sa: तेषां नारायणनरौ तपस्तेपतुरव्ययौ। बदर्याश्रममासाद्य शकटे कनकामये॥
en: Amongst them all, Narayana and Nara practised severest austerities by going to the Himalayan retreat known by the name of Vadari, and riding on their golden cars.

sa: प्रसक्तान् पततोऽद्राक्षम भारद्वाजस्य सायकान्। मण्डलीकृतमेवास्य धनुश्चादृश्यताद्भुतम्॥
en: We then beheld the arrows shot by Bharadvaja's son fall in unbroken lines and his bow present the wonderful appearance of always being drawn to a circle.

sa: सारथेस्तु रथस्थस्य काश्यपेयस्य विस्मिताः। नभस्तलगताश्चैव देवगन्धर्वदानवाः॥
en: Caused by the charioteer Daruka the Kasyapa's race, stationed on the car, struck (everybody) with wonder. The celestials, the Gandharvas and the Danavas stationed in the firmament.

sa: आचार्योऽपनिधिश्चैव भय॑ते तदनन्तरम्। अर्थयुक्त्या प्रवत्स्यन्ति मित्रसम्बन्धिबान्धवाः॥
en: Preceptors impoverished for the want of wealth will be disregarded by men. Friends and relations and kinsmen will perform friendly offices for only the sake of wealth.

sa: आक्रम्याक्रम्य साधूनां दारांश्चापिधनानि च। भोक्ष्यन्ते निरनुक्रोशा रुदतामपि भारत॥
en: Again and again attacking the good and the honest and feeling no pity for them even when they will cry in grief, the Kshatriyas will, O descendant of Bharata, rob them of their wives and wealth.

sa: इन्द्रियाणां निरोधेन सर्वेषां विषयैषिणाम्। मुनेर्जनपदत्यागादध्यात्माग्निः समिध्यते॥
en: Through suppression of all the senses which always hanker after their objects, and abandonment of inhabited places, the spiritual fire blazes forth in the man of contemplation.

sa: तपसा स्वर्गगमनं भोगो दानेन जायते। ज्ञानेन मोक्षो विज्ञेयस्तीर्थस्नानादधक्षयः॥
en: One may obtain heaven by asceticism, one may obtain objects of enjoyments by the practice of charity, one may have his sins all destroyed by bathing in Tirthas, but complete emancipation cannot be obtained without knowledge.

sa: नानाशस्रधरैोरै नाकवचभूषणैः॥ वृतं घटोत्कचं क्रूरैर्मरुद्भिरिव वासवम्।
en: All bearing various kinds of weapons and wearing diverse kinds of armour and ornaments indeed beholding Ghatotkacha surrounded by these fearful Rakshasas like Vasava by the Marutas.

sa: विशेषयिष्यन्नाचार्ये सर्वास्त्रविदुषां वरः। मुमोच षट्शतान् बाणान् गृहीत्वैकमिव दुतम्॥
en: That foremost of all men versed in the use of weapons getting the better of his preceptor, quickly discharged six hundred arrows; that looked as if he had taken out and shot only a single arrow.

sa: मुक्तसङ्गोऽनहंवादी धृत्युत्साहसमन्वितः। सिद्ध्यसिद्ध्योर्निर्विकारः कर्ता सात्त्विक उच्यते॥
en: Sattva Agent is he who is free from attachment, and egoism, who is full of constancy and energy and who is unmoved both in success and failure.

sa: तस्मिन् व्रजति दुर्धर्षे प्रास्खलद् रुक्मिणी पथि। तन्नामर्षयत श्रीमांस्ततस्तूर्णमचोदयत्॥
en: As the irresistible Durvasas proceeded on the car, Rukmini tottered on the road and frequently dropped down. At this the twiceborn Rishi became angry and began to urge Rukmini on by striking her with the whip.

sa: अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि सर्वं विविधमिन्द्रियम्। पादावध्यात्ममित्याहुर्ब्राह्मणास्तत्त्वदर्शिनः॥
en: After this I shall describe everything about the various (other) organs. Brahmanas knowing the truth say that the two feet are mentioned as connected with the soul.

sa: सोऽश्वमेधसहस्रेण राजसूयशतेन च। पुनरीजे महायज्ञैः समाप्तवरदक्षिणैः॥
en: Having accomplished all those sacrifices he once more performed a thousand great Horsesacrifices and a hundred such Rajasuya, in which he made profuse gifts to the Brahmanas.

sa: मत्तकोकिलसंनादैर्नर्तयन्निव पादपान्। शैलकंदरनिष्क्रान्तः प्रगीत इव चानिलः॥
en: While issuing out of the mountainous hollows the wind is singing as it were and making the trees dance with the musical notes of the delighted cuckoos.

sa: एवमस्त्विति तेनासौ मृगेन्द्रेणाभिपूजितः। प्राप्तवान् मतिसाचिव्यं गोमायुर्व्याघ्रयोनितः॥
en: Thus addressed by the jackal, the king of beasts answered him,-Let it be so!-and showed him every honour. The jackal then accepted the ministership of the tiger.

sa: शराभिघातसंरब्धः सोऽभिजग्राह सायकान्। काकुत्स्थः सुमहातेजा युगान्तादित्यवर्चसः।।।।
en: With his ire aroused by the blows he received the exceedingly energetic Kākutstha took up arrows resembling the sur risen at the time of the universal dissolution.

sa: दुन्दुभिर्मेघनिर्घोषो मुहुर्मुहुरताड्यत। विननादासकृच्चापि दिवसे दिवसे गते॥
en: And so large was the number fed that the sounds of drums and cymbals were heard again and again. Indeed, those sounds continued from day to day.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा क्रोधताम्राक्षस्तमाश्रमनिवासिनम्। जनं जनपदान्तेषु स्थीयतामिति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: Having said this, with eyes reddened with ire, USanas, Bhrgu's son, said to the inmates of his hermitage: Do you all go and wait outside this kingdom.

sa: नगरीरक्षिणो भुङ्क्ते श्वपचप्रवणो भवेत्॥
en: By accepting food from the warder of a city, one degenerates to the status, of the lowest outcast.

sa: पन्थानः सर्वनेतारो यशवाहाः सनातनाः। पितृपैतामहीं गुर्वीमुद्वहन्ति धुरं सदा॥
en: They are the path or road along which all should go. They are the guides of all. They are the eternal upholders of all the sacrifices. They always upholds the heavy loads of fathers and grandfathers.

sa: कामक्रोधावनादृत्य धर्ममेवानुपालय। धर्मः श्रेयस्करतमो राज्ञां भरतसत्तम॥
en: Disregarding lust and anger follow the dictates of righteousness. Of all things, O chief of Bharata's race, which secure the prosperity of kings, righteousness is the foremost.

sa: सानुकर्षपताकैश्च द्विपाश्वरथभूषणैः। स्यन्दनैरपविद्धैश्च भग्नचक्राक्षकूबरैः॥
en: With flag-staffs and car-bottoms; with ornaments of cars, elephants and steeds; with shattered chariots, wheels, axels and Kuvaras;

sa: वनं प्रवाजिताश्चास्म वल्कलाजिनवाससः। अनर्हमाणास्तं भावं त्रयोदश समा: परैः॥
en: We were exiled, with barks of trees or skins of animals for our cloth and cover. Through undeserving of such a wretched plight, yet we were compelled to wear out thirteen long years in that condition.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच असौम्याः सौम्यरूपेण सौम्याश्चासौम्यदर्शनाः। ईदृशान् पुरुषांस्तात कथं विद्यामहे वयम्॥
en: Yudhishthira said Many persons here, who do not in reality, possess of tranquil souls, appear external as men of tranquil souls. There are again others, who are really of tranquil souls but that appear otherwise. How, O sire, shall we succeed in knowing these people.

sa: यश्चेदंधारयेन्नित्यं शृणुयाद् वाप्यभीक्ष्णशः। पुत्रार्थी लभते पुत्रंधनार्थी लभतेधनम्। विद्यार्थी लभते विद्यां पुरुषोऽप्यथवा स्त्रियः॥
en: A man or a woman that recites or hears this hymn day after day, if he or she is desirous of a son, obtains one; if desirous of wealth, cbtains it; and if desirous of learning, obtains it. The man or woman who always reads it in the two twlights (early morning and evening).

sa: अस्त्रैरस्त्राणि संवार्य द्रौणे: शारद्वतस्य च। मन्दवेगानिपूंस्ताभ्यामजिघांसुरवासृजत्॥
en: And unwillingly warded off the weapons of the sons of Drona and Saradvat, by means of his own weapons and discharged at them arrows of milder speed.

sa: सोऽजिघांसुर्मुरं संख्ये गुरोस्तनयमवे च। चकाराचार्यकं तत्र कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः॥
en: Dhananjaya, the son of Kunti, not liking to slay his preceptor (i.e. Kripa) and his (other) preceptor's son (i.e. Ashvatthama) in battle began to act like a preceptor (teaching the science of arms of his pupil).

sa: जातरूपपरिष्कारैर्धनुर्भिः सुमहाखनैः। सुवर्णपु?रिषुभिर्नाराचैश्च सहस्रशः॥
en: With gold-decked bows of fierce twang and with thousands of arrows and darts furnished with wings of gold.

sa: देवमाल्यापनयनं द्विजोच्छिष्टावमार्जनम्॥ आकल्प: परिचर्या च गात्रसंवाहनानि च। अत्रैकैकं नृपश्रेष्ठ गोदानाद्ध्यतिरिच्यते॥
en: The removal of garlands of flowers offered to the gods, the removal of the remnant of a Brahmana's food, serving with prepared pastes, the shampooing of a Brahmana's legs, O foremost of kings, each of these gives better fruits than the giving away of kine.

sa: पश्य मे निशितान्बाणानिरपुदर्पनिषूदनान्। ईश्वरायुधसंकाशांस्तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणान्। ५५ ।।
en: Behold my whetted arrows-crushers of the insolence of foes resembling the weapon itself of the Lord,* adorned with burnished gold. *Isvara, Siva, His weapon is the trident.

sa: ऋत्विग् गुरुस्तथाऽऽचार्यः स्नातको नृपतिः प्रियः। सर्वमेतद्धृषीकेशस्तस्मादभ्यर्चितोऽच्युतः॥
en: Hrishikesha (Krishna) is the Ritvija, preceptor, worthy of being solicited to marry one's daughter, the Snataka, the king and the friend. Therefore, Achyuta (Krishna) has been worshipped.

sa: कलायां जायतेऽजस्रं पुनः पुनरबुद्धिमान्। धाम तस्योपयुञ्जन्ति भूय एवोपजायते॥
en: Invested with Ignorance, Individual Soul repeatedly and continually takes birth in the fifteen portions, named above. With the etemai and immutable portion of Individual Soul the principal elements become united and this union takes place repeatedly.

sa: आत्मबुद्ध्या समास्थाय शान्तीभूतो निरामयः। अमृतं विरजः शुद्धमात्मानं प्रतिपद्यते॥
en: Having become tranquillity's self, and being freed from all sorts of calamity, such a person, by depending upon his own intelligence, attains to that Soul which is pure and immortal and which is without a stain.'

sa: तां गतिं परमामेति निवृत्तिपरमो मुनिः। ज्ञानतत्त्वपरो नित्यं शुभाशुभनिदर्शकः॥
en: The ascetic who wish to discriminate exactly between good and evil, who is always bent on conceiving the nature of the Soul, and who devotes himself to the religion of disinclination, attains to that high end.

sa: अव्यक्तः पावनोऽचिन्त्यः सहस्रांशुर्हिरण्मयः। आदिर्गणानां सर्वेषां भवान् वै जीविताश्चयः॥
en: You are the Unmanifest, you are Pavana, you are inconceivable, you are the thousand rayed Sun, you are the shining intelligence, you are the first of all the subjects, and you are the support of life.

sa: प्रकाशं भगवानेतदृषिर्नारायणोऽमृतम्। भूतानामनुकम्पार्थं जगाद जगतो गतिः॥
en: The divine Rishi Narayana, that refuge of the universe, for the sake of mercy towards all creatures, distinctly laid down these means for the acquisition of immortality.

sa: उपद्रवांस्तथा रोगान् हितजीर्णमिताशनात्। लोभं मोहं च संतोषाद् विषयास्तत्त्वदर्शनात्॥
en: By frugal and easily digestible food one should dispell all disorders and diseases. By contentment one should remove greed and stupefaction of judgement, and all earthly concerns should be avoided by a knowledge of the truth.

sa: छित्त्वाधर्ममयं पाशं यदा धर्मेऽभिरज्यते। दत्त्वाभयकृतं दानं तदा सिद्धिमवाप्नुते॥
en: When one, snapping the fetters of sin, begins to take pleasure in virtue, and when one makes that highest of all gifts, viz., the promise of all harmlessness to all creatures, then does one acquire success.

sa: अगाधजन्मामरणं च राजन् निरामयं वीतभयं शिवं च। ज्ञानस्य तत्त्वार्थमिदं विदित्वा॥
en: Seeing Brahma whose sight is capable of doing away with both birth and death, O king, which is full of auspiciousness, which removes all fear, and which yields the highest benefit, and having acquired this essence of all knowledge, renounce all error and stupefaction to-day.

sa: त्रैलोक्यं तपसा व्याप्तमन्तर्भूतेन भास्वता। सूर्यश्च चन्द्रमाश्चैव भासतस्तपसा दिवि॥
en: The universe is permeated by yoga power secretly passing through every part of it and lighting it up brightly. The sun and the moon shine in the sky of the heart on account of yoga power.

sa: जनको युवनाश्वच वृषादर्भिः प्रसेनजित्। लोभक्षयाद् दिवं प्राप्तास्तथैवान्ये नराधिपाः॥
en: From ignorance proceeds covetousness, and from the latter proceeds ignorance. Covetousness produces all faults. For these reasons every one should avoid covetousness. Janaka, Yuvanashva, Vrishadarbhi, Prasenajit, and other kings acquired heaven for their having conquered covetousness.

sa: अप्रियाण्यवमानांश्च दुःखं बहुविधात्मकम्। फलार्थी तत्फलं त्यक्त्वा प्राप्नोति विषयात्मकम्॥
en: He, however, who, by abandoning (pure penances), undertakes penances from desire of fruit, suffers from many disagreeable consequences, and disgrace and sorrow of all sorts, as the fruits thereof, all of which originate from worldly possessions.

sa: यत्र पूर्वाभिसर्गे वै धर्मचक्र प्रवर्तितम्। नैमिषे गोमतीतीरे तत्र नागाह्वयं पुरम्॥
en: In that place whence in course of a former creation, the wheel of virtue was set in motion, in that forest which is known by the name of Naimisha, and which is situate on the banks of the Gomati, there is a city called Nagapura.

sa: विज्ञातमेवं भवतु करिष्ये प्रियमात्मनः। गत्वाऽऽश्रमपदाद् दूरमुटजं कृतवास्तु सः॥
en: Let this, however, be settled, that I shall do what would be for my behoof. Proceeding to a spot that was distant from that hermitage, he inade a hut of the twigs and leaves of trees.

sa: अग्नौ प्रास्ताहुतिर्ब्रह्मचादित्यमुपगच्छति॥ आदित्याज्जायते वृष्टिर्वृष्टेरन्नं ततः प्रजाः।
en: The libations poured on the sacrificial fire get up to the Sun. From the Sun originates rain. From rain comes food. From food are born living creatures.

sa: दिग्वासः कीर्त्यते कोऽन्यो लोके कश्चोर्ध्वरेतसः। कस्य चार्धे स्थिता कान्ता अनङ्ग केन निर्जितः।।२१७।
en: Who else in this world is described as having the horizon only for his dress? Who else can be said to be a celibate with vital seed drawn up? Who else is there who has half his body occupied by his dear wife. Who else is there who has been able to subjugate Cupid?

sa: कर्मणा यत्र पापेन वर्तन्ते जीवितेप्सवः। व्यवधावेत् ततस्तूर्णं ससर्पाच्छरणादिव॥
en: One should fly away quickly from that place, as if from a room which there is a snake, where the inhabitants, desirous of acquiring the means of life, are engaged in the practice of sinful deeds.

sa: भृगुरुवाच असृजद् ब्राह्मणानेव पूर्वं ब्रह्मा प्रजापतीन्। आत्मतेजोभिनिर्वृत्तान् भास्कराग्निसमप्रभान्॥
en: Bhrigu said Brahman first created a few Brahmanas who passed by the name of Prajapatis (lord of creation). Effulgent like the fire or the Sun, they were created out of the energy of that First-born Being.

sa: हेतुभिर्वा किमन्यैस्तैरीश: कारणकारणम्। न शुश्रुम यदन्यस्य लिङ्गमभ्यर्चितं सुरैः॥
en: What necessity is there, of other reasons? The great Mahadeva is the cause of all causes. We have never heard that the celestials have, at any time worshipped the emblem of any other god than Mahadeva.

sa: ताम्येयुः प्रच्युताः पृथ्वीं मोहपूर्णा नदी नराः। यथा गाधमविद्वांसो बुद्धियोगमयं तथा॥
en: As men not knowing the bottom become distressed when they fall upon this Earth which is like a river filled with the waters of stupefaction, so is that man pained who falls away from that state in which there is a union with the Understanding.

sa: आश्रयो नास्ति सत्त्वस्य गुणसर्गेण चेतना। सत्त्वमस्य सृजन्त्यन्ये गुणान् वेद कदाचन॥
en: The Understanding has no refuge. That which is called life originates from the effects of the qualities coming together. Others, acting as causes, create the Understanding that lives in the body. No one can apprehend the qualities in the true nature or from of existence.

sa: ततः कदाचिच्छिष्यास्तं परिवार्यावतस्थिरे। वेदाध्ययनसम्पन्नाः शान्तात्मानो जितेन्द्रियाः॥
en: One day as he was seated his disciples, all well-read in the Vedas, having their senses under control, and gifted with tranquil souls, sat themselves around him.

sa: सहस्रनयनश्चापि वज्री शम्बरपाकहा। तस्या देवर्षिजुष्टायास्तीरमभ्याजगाम ह॥
en: At that time the thousand-eyed Indra also, the holder of the thunder-bolt, and the destroyer of Shamvara and Paka, came to the very shore where Narada was.

sa: प्रवृत्तिलक्षणश्चैव धर्मो नारायणात्मकः। नारायणात्मको गन्धो भूमौ श्रेष्ठतमः स्मृतः॥
en: The other Religion which has Action for its root, has equally Narayana for its Soul. The foremost of all the qualities that belong to the element of Earth is scent. Scent has Narayana for its soul.

sa: अधिष्ठानानि वुद्धेर्हि पृथगानि पञ्चधा। इन्द्रियाणीति यान्याहुस्तान्यदृश्योऽधितिष्ठति॥
en: The foundations of the Intelligence are five in number, cach serving a different purpose. They are called the sense. The invisible principle. viz., Intelligence, Depends on them.

sa: व्रतिभिर्बहुभिः कीर्णं तापसैरुपसेवितम्। ब्राह्मणैश्च महाभागैः सूर्यज्वलनसंनिभैः॥
en: Many Brahmacharins lived there, and many herimits. Many Brahmanas lived there, who were highly blessed and who resembled the sun or the fire in energy and effulgence.

sa: ततोऽभिषिच्य राज्येन देवानां दिवि वासवम्। सप्तर्षयश्चान्वयुञ्जन् नराणां दण्डधारणे॥
en: Then the seven ancient Rishis came forward and installed Vasava as the king of the gods and the ruler of heaven. And they took upon themselves the task of holding the rod of punishment over mankind.

sa: नक्तंचर्या दिवास्वप्नमालस्यं पैशुनं मदम्। अतियोगमयोगं च श्रेयसोऽर्थी परित्यजेत्॥
en: Walking in the night, sleep during the day, indulgence in idleness, villainy, pride, excessive indulgence and total abstention from enjoyment in objects of the senses, should be shunned by one desirous of acquiring what is excellent.

sa: तथैव मृगजातीभिरन्याभिरभिशोभसे। तथा सर्वाधिवासैश्च शोभसे मेरुवद्रुम्॥
en: Similarly various other animals living in the woods, also adorn you. Indeed, O tree, you appear beautiful even like the mountains of Meru, peopled by all creatures.

sa: तद्विश्वभावसंज्ञान्तं पौरुषी तनुमाश्रितम्॥ सोऽनिरुद्ध इति प्रोक्तस्तत् प्रधानं प्रचक्षते।
en: Brahma that originates from primeval Darkness develops into the idea of the universe, and assumes the form of Purusha. Such Purusha is called Aniruddha. Shorn of sex, it is called otherwise by the name of Pradhana

sa: अवैरकृत् सूपचारः समो निन्दाप्रशंसयोः। सुवृत्तः शीलसम्पन्नः प्रसन्नात्मऽऽत्मवान् प्रभुः॥
en: Shom of vindictiveness and all sorts of guile, and unaffected by praise and censure, such a man is well-behaved, has good manners is pure of soul, had fortitude, and is a complete master of his passions.

sa: धर्मादुत्कृष्यते श्रेयस्तथाश्रेयोऽप्यधर्मतः। रागवान् प्रकृति ह्येति विरक्तो ज्ञानवान् भवेत्॥
en: From righteousness creatures obtain a great end, and from sinfulness they earn a low end. He who is not freed from attachments, goes through rebirth; while he who is freed therefrom, attains to Knowledge (or Brahma).

sa: यथा सर्वरसैस्तृप्तो नाभिनन्दति किंचन॥ तथा प्रज्ञानतृप्तस्य नित्यतृप्तिः सुखोदया।
en: As one who is satisfied with all sorts of taste fells no desire for any particular taste, similarly one who is pleased with knowledge has eternal gratification which to him is a source of perfect happiness.

sa: स एव हृदि सर्वासु मूर्तिष्वातिष्ठतेऽऽत्मवान्। केवलश्चेतनो नित्यः सर्वमूर्तिरमूर्तिमान्॥
en: It is that Unmanifest, which, when endued with body lives in the hearts of all creatures having body. As regards eternal Consciousness, although he is shorn of attributes and without form, yet he assumes all forins.

sa: फेनमात्रोपमो देहे जीवे शकुनिवत् स्थिते। अनित्ये प्रियसंवासे कथं स्वपिषि पुत्रक॥
en: Your body is as fickle as the froth on the surface of water. The Individual Soul is sitting unattached in it as a bird on a tree. The companionship of all agreeable objects is transitory. Why then, O son, do you sleep in such forgetfulness?

sa: दानवेन्द्रास्त्वतिक्रम्य तत् पितामहशासनम्। धर्मस्यापचयं चक्रुः क्रोधलोभसमन्विताः॥
en: Disregarding the cominands of the Grandfather, and giving way to anger and covetousness, the foremost of the Danavas, however, began to bring about the destruction of virtue.

sa: अक्षरक्षरयोरेतदुक्तं तव निदर्शनम्। मयेह ज्ञानसम्पन्नं यथाश्रुतिनिदर्शनात्॥
en: I have now told you according to what I have heard, as to how knowledge that is subtile, pure and certain, originates. Do you listen to me.

sa: तीर्थानां हृदयं तीर्थं शुचानां हृदयं शुचिः। सर्वमार्यकृतं चौक्ष्यं वालसंस्पर्शनानि च।॥
en: The heart of all sacred places and shrines is the Preceptor. The heart of all pure and cleansing things is Fire. All acts done by a good and pious person are good and praiseworthy, including even the touching of the hair of a cow's tail.

sa: यदा सर्वं परित्यज्य गन्तव्यमवशेन ते। अनर्थे किं प्रसक्तस्त्वं स्वमर्थं नानुतिष्ठसि॥
en: When it is certain that you shall have to go helplessly to the other world, leaving behind all these things, alas, why do you then allow yourself to be attached to such worthless unsubstantial things, without attending to what forms your real and durable wealth?

sa: तपश्चर्यापरः सद्यः पापाद् विपरिमुच्यते॥ संवत्सरमुपास्याग्निमभिशस्तः प्रमुच्यते।
en: One who practises ascetic austerities is soon purged of all one's sins. By adoring the sacrificial fire for a year, one sullied by various sins becomes purified.

sa: एवं चतुर्णां वर्णानमाश्रमाणां प्रवृत्तिषु। एकमालम्बमानानां निर्णये किं निरामयम्॥
en: Tell me, in what then, if we are to determine the question of happiness, consists pure happiness for all the four castes and all the four modes of life who and which have the same basis.

sa: वैश्यः कश्चिदृषिसुतं काश्यपं संशितव्रतम्। रथेन पातयामास श्रीमान् दृप्तस्तपस्विनम्॥
en: Once on a time a rich Vaishya, enjoying the highest state of prosperity and elated with his affluence, threw down, by rashly driving his car, a Rishi's son of rigid vows, named Kashyapa, given to penances.

sa: इदं महर्षेर्वचनं विनिश्चितं महात्मनः पुरुषवरस्य कीर्तितम्। समागमं चर्षिदिवौकसामिमं निशम्य भक्ताः सुसुखं लभन्ते॥
en: Hearing these words of the great Rishi, fraught with certainty of conclusion, and containing a recital of the attributes of that great one who is the foremost of all beings, hearing this narrative of the great assembly of Rishis and other dwellers of heaven,-men who are devoted to the Supreme Deity derive great happiness.

sa: पुरा प्राप ब्रह्मलोकादयं स्वर्गे स्तवराजोऽवतारितः। यतस्तण्डि: तेन तण्डिकृतोऽभवत्॥
en: This king of all hymns was first taken from the region of Brahman to heaven, the region of the gods. Tandi then got it from heaven. Hence it is known as the hynin composed by Tandi.

sa: अनात्मेति च यद् दृष्टं तेनाह न ममेत्यपि। वर्तते किमधिष्ठानात् प्रसक्तादुःखपमृतिः॥
en: Those persons, who, however, regard alll worldly objects as not-Soui, and who on that account cease to have any affection or attachment for them, have never to suffer any misery, for sorrow, in their case, stands in need of some foundation upon which to depend.

sa: चिरकारी महाप्राज्ञो गौतमस्याभवत् सुतः। चिरेण सर्वकार्याणि विमृश्यार्थान् प्रपद्यते॥
en: There was once a highly wise man by name Chirakarin, who was the son of Gautama. Thinking for a long time upon every aspect of proposed acts, he used to do all he had to do.

sa: यं ज्ञात्वा अन्तकालेऽपि गच्छेत परमां गतिम्। पवित्रं मङ्गलं मेध्यं कल्याणमिदमुत्तमम्॥
en: If one, even on the eve of death, recites it or hears it recited to him, he succeeds in attaining to the highest end. This is holy. This is auspicious, this is fraught with every sort of benefit. This is the best of all things.

sa: अलसग्रहणं प्राप्तो दुर्मेधावी तथोच्यते। बुद्धिलाघवयुक्तेन जनेनादीर्घदर्शिना॥
en: But still he passed for an idle man. He was also considered as a foolish person, by every person of a light understanding and shorn of foresight.

sa: अप्राप्तदमकाश्चैव नासानां वेधकाश्च ये। बन्धकाश्च पशूनां ये ते वै निरयगामिनः॥
en: They who set bullocks to work when the animals have not come of age, they who bore the noses of bullocks and other animals for controlling them the better while engaged in work, and they who keep animals always tethered, have to sink in hell.

sa: ब्रह्मशिरोपहर्ताय महिषघ्नाय वै नमः। नमः स्त्रीरूपधाराय यज्ञविध्वंसनाय च॥
en: I bow to you who cut off one of the heads of the Grandfather Brahma, to you who have killed the Asura named Mahisha, to you who have three forms, to you who have every form.

sa: जन्ममृत्युजरादुःखैर्व्याधिभिर्मानसक्लमैः। दृष्ट्वैव संततं लोकं घटेन्मोक्षाय बुद्धिमान्॥
en: Seeing the world beset with the evils formed by birth, death, decrepitude, sorrow, disease, and anxieties, the man of intelligence should try for the attainment of Liberation.

sa: निष्क्रम्य वनमास्थाय ज्ञानयुक्तो जितेन्द्रियः। कालाकाङ्क्षी चरत्येवं ब्रह्मभूयाय कल्पते॥
en: Retiring from the world, and living in the woods, that learned person, having a complete mastery over the senses who treads in that path, expecting his own demise, is sure to acquire the state of Brahma.

sa: अहिंसा सकलो धर्मो हिंसाधर्मस्तथाहितः। सत्यं तेऽहं प्रवक्ष्यामि यो धर्मः सत्यवादिनाम्॥
en: Abstention from injury is the religion which is perfect about its rewards. The religion of cruelty is only so far beneficial that it leads to heaven. I have described to you the religion of Truth which, indeed, is the religion of those who utter Brahma.

sa: मेघसंकुलमाकाशं विद्युन्मण्डलमण्डितम्। संछन्नस्तु मुहूर्तेन नौसाथैरिव सागरः॥
en: In a moment dense masses of clouds set in the sky, accompanied with lightning and presenting the view of a sea covered with merchant boats and vessels.

sa: कस्मिंश्चात्मा निधातव्यस्त्रिवर्गविजयाय वै। संहष्टा नैष्ठिकं वाक्यं यथावद् वक्तुमर्हथ॥
en: For suppressing the three vices, viz., lust, anger and covetousness), upon which of the first three (viz., Virtue, Profit and Desire) should the mind be fixed? You should all cheerfully answer this question in true words.

sa: तमप्यनुपमात्मानं विश्वं शम्भुः प्रजापतिः। अणिमा लघिमा प्राप्तिरीशानो ज्योतिरव्ययः॥
en: The incomparable Universe is then devoured by Shambhu, that Lord of all things in whom exist the lordly powers of Anima, Laghima, Prapti, etc., and who is considered as Supreme and pure Effulgence that is Iminutable.

sa: अनेन धर्मप्राप्त्यर्थं शुभा दत्ता पुरानघ। धेनुर्विप्राय राजर्षे तप:स्वाध्यायशीलिने॥
en: This Vikrita had, in days gone by, for the sake of acquiring merit, O sinless onc, given away an auspicious cow, O royal sage, to a Brahmana given to penances and the study of the Vedas.

sa: अथ तस्य जटाः क्लिना बभूवुर्ग्रथिताः प्रभो। अरण्यगमनान्नित्यं मलिनोऽमलसंयुतः॥
en: He had to pass through the forests again and again. Partly with exposure to the rains and partly with the filth they caught, the locks of that pure Rishi became entangled and intertwined with one another.

sa: अर्थस्यावयवावेतौ धर्मकामाविति श्रुतिः। अर्थसिद्ध्या विनिर्वृत्तावुभावेतौ भविष्यतः॥
en: Virtue and Desire are the limbs of Wealth as the Shruti says. With the acquisition of Wealth, both Virtue and the objects of desire may be acquired.

sa: उभयं सम्प्रधायैतदध्यवस्येद् यथामति। अनेनैव विधानेन भवेद् गर्भशयो महान्॥
en: Meditating duly upon these two opinions, one should try his best according to the way one thinks proper. It is by this way that one should acquire eminence and take refuge in his own Soul alone.

sa: अयमत्र भवेद् बन्धुरनेन सह मे क्षमम्। साम्यमेकत्वमायातो यादृशस्तादृशस्त्वहम्॥
en: The Supreme Soul alone is my friend. I can make friendship with Him. Whatever be my nature and whoever I may be, I am capable to be like Him and can become at one with Him.

sa: जल्पनाभ्यवहारार्थं मुखमिन्द्रियमुच्यते। गमनेन्द्रियं तथा पादौ कर्मणः करणे करौ॥
en: The mouth is spoken of as an organ of action because it contains the instrument of speech, and that of eating. The feet are organs of locomotion and the hands for doing various sorts of work.

sa: अव्यक्तः सत्त्वसंयुक्तो देवलोकमवाप्नुयात्॥ रजःसत्त्वसमायुक्तो मानुषेषु प्रपद्यते। रजस्तमोभ्यां संयुक्तस्तिर्यग्योनिषु जायते॥ राजसैस्तामसैः सत्त्वैर्युक्तो मानुषमाप्नुयात्।
en: When the Purusha becomes endued with only Sattva, he aquires the region of the gods. Endued with both Sattva and Rajas, he is born as a man. Endued with Rajas and Tamas, he is born the intermediate order of Being. Endued with all three, viz., Sattva and Rajas and Tamas, he becomes a man.

sa: सर्वमव्यक्तमित्युक्तमसर्वः पञ्चविंशकः। य एनमभिजानन्ति न भयं तेषु विद्यते॥
en: All things, have been said to be the result of the Unmanifest. The Soul, which is the twentyfifth, is above all things. They who know the Soul have no fear of coming back to the world.

sa: सर्वमेतन्महाबाहो दिव्यभावसमन्वितम्। प्रसादाद् देवदेवस्य ईश्वरस्य महात्मनः॥
en: O you of mighty arms, all these are gifted with a celestial nature through the favour of that god of gods, that supreme Lord, that great Deity.

sa: ज्येष्ठाच्चाप्यनुसंक्रान्तो राजानमविकम्पनम्। अन्तर्दधे ततो राजन्नेष धर्मः प्रभो हरेः॥
en: From the Brahmana known by the name of Jeshthya, this religion was obtained by a king of the name of Avikampana. After this, that religion, derived from the powerful Hari, once more disappeared from the world.

sa: अदृष्टपूर्वानादाय भावानपरिशङ्कितान्। इष्टानिष्टान् मनुष्याणामस्तं गच्छन्ति रात्रयः॥
en: The nights are continually going away, taking with them the good and bad incidents that befall man, that depend on destiny, and that are unexpected by him.

sa: ततो ब्राह्मणरूपेण देवराजः शतक्रतुः। भेदयामास तान् गत्वा नगरं वै नृपात्मजान्॥
en: He said to them, Brothers never remain at peace even when they are the children of the same father. The sons of the sage Kashyapa, viz., the gods and the Asuras, fell out with each other on account of the sovereignty of the three worlds.

sa: स्तमेव राजनपुनराविशन्ति। इमे तथा ज्ञानमहाजलौघा नारायणं वै पुनराविशन्ति॥
en: As waves of the ocean, rising from the ocean, rush away from it only to return to it in the long run so various sorts of knowledge, originating from Narayana, return to Narayana in the end.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा ब्राह्मणाय दैवसिकामुत्पत्तिं प्रादात्। अधिकस्याश्वसहस्रस्य मूल्यमेवादादिति॥
en: Markandeya said : Having said this, he gave the Brahmana whatever came to him that day which was not more than the value of one thousand horses.

sa: आत्मनिन्दाऽऽत्मपूजा च परनिन्दा परस्तवः। अनाचरितमार्याणां वृत्तमेतच्चतुर्विधम्॥
en: O Bhishma, have you not heard that reproach and glorification of self and reproach and glorification of others are not the practices of those who are respectable?

sa: बृहच्छाल इवानूपे शाखापुष्यपलाशवान्॥ हस्ती श्वेत इवाज्ञातः कथं जिष्णुश्चरिष्यति।
en: A large tree with spreading branches; flowers and with leaves in a well watered place (can never remain hidden). Nor can the Airavat (Indra's elephant). How will Jishnu (Arjuna) be able to live undiscovered and unknown?

sa: पुरायोनियुधाजिच्च अभिया मुदितो भवः। स्वर्णेता सहजिद् बभुरिति राजाभिधीयते॥
en: The monarch is further styled 'the prime cause,' (of social order), 'the conqueror of battles,' (and therefore) the preserver of the (peace), 'the watchman', 'the contented', 'the lord', 'guide to heaven,' 'the easily victorious', 'Vishnu like.'

sa: प्रगृह्याथधनुष्कोट्या ज्यापाशेनावकृष्य च। मुष्टिभिश्चापि हतवान् वज्रकल्पैर्महाद्युतिः॥
en: Taking up the bow and dragging him (the Kirata) with his bow-string, the greally effulgent (Arjuna) struck him some fearful blows which descended upon him as thunderbolis.

sa: सहस्रस्तम्भां हेमवैदूर्यचित्रां शतद्वारां तोरणस्फाटिकाख्याम्। सभामग्यां क्रोशमात्रायतां मे तद्विस्तारामाशु कुर्वन्तु युक्ताः॥
en: “Build with all care as soon as possible an Assembly-hall of the most beautiful description to be called” crystal-gate palace” with one thousand pillars and one thousand gates, decked with gold and Vaidurya gems and extending two miles in length and two miles in breadth".

sa: आसन् वर्षसहरीयास्तथा पुत्रसहहिरणः। तत: कालान्तरेऽन्यस्मिन् पृथिवीतलचारिणः॥
en: They lived for a thousand years and had as many sons. But in process of time their powers, were limited to walking solely on the earth's surface.
